canonical_statement_ko:
QuTE는 양자컴퓨터를 물리적으로 복제하는 프로젝트가 아니다.
QuTE는 제한되고 검증된 양자 workload를 물리 제약이 반영된
신경 연산자로 컴파일하여, 고전 AI 하드웨어에서 양자 백엔드처럼
실행하고, 불확실하거나 범위 밖인 요청은 시뮬레이터 또는 QPU로
전달하는 AI-native quantum runtime을 만드는 프로젝트다.
canonical_statement_en:
QuTE compiles restricted and verified quantum workloads into
physics-constrained neural execution backends running on classical
AI hardware, while routing uncertain or out-of-domain requests to
classical simulators or physical QPUs.
slogan: Compile quantum workloads into verified neural execution backends.

P3.name: Operator/channel-first representation
P3.scale_rule: Small-qubit diagnostics may use full states/unitaries; larger systems must use compressed or query-based representations.

P4.name: Physical structure by construction
P4.rule: Freeze physical structure, not Cayley, recurrence, Transformer, or another implementation.

P5.name: No exponential output requirement at scale

P6.name: OOD detection and fallback are product requirements

P8.name: Honest scientific evaluation
requires: opened sealed sets never become development sets

P9.name: Implementation flexibility
P9.rule: Implementation hypotheses may change without changing the North Star.

P10.name: Project boundaries
P10.rule: Core, Runtime, Hardware Twin, Feynman, augmentation research, and Benchmark remain separately classified.

non_goals: claiming efficient exact simulation of arbitrary quantum circuits
claiming a classical neural network is a physical quantum computer
scaling full state/full unitary outputs indefinitely
using model size alone as the primary research strategy
optimizing against an already opened final test
shipping a neural backend without OOD/fallback protection
treating language explanation as the primary execution core
claiming quantum advantage from four-qubit surrogate fitting
hiding teacher-data, training, or fallback cost
calling one restricted workload result universal

P4.5: model scaling without sufficient data caused overfitting
raw parameter scaling was not the dominant solution
P4.6: circuit/probe allocation showed a mixed data effect
explicit operator factorization was stronger than direct state regression
exact-unitary structure was stronger than soft-unitarity regularization in the frozen experiment
exact operator supervision alone did not explain all gains
P4.7: recurrent encoding was supported by three-seed validation evidence
composition self-consistency produced a composition-specific validation gain with balanced-score trade-off
privileged prefix-action supervision was not supported
P4.8: recurrent evidence became qualified on untouched sealed evaluation
the current composition-consistency hypothesis was not supported on sealed Composition-OOD
overall sealed verdict was partially supported
candidate roles were not changed after test access

scientific_interpretation: explicit operator representation and hard physical structure remain the strongest surviving architecture direction
recurrent encoding remains a useful but unconfirmed-by-strongest-criterion development backbone
the current soft composition loss must not be treated as a verified solution
failure of a particular architecture/loss is not failure of the QuTE North Star

short_term_goals.ST-1: Publish and archive P4.5–P4.8 as mechanism decomposition and OOD methodology, preserving positive and negative findings.
short_term_goals.ST-2: Build one restricted Workload Emulator MVP for observable/sample/gradient/uncertainty outputs without requiring full state.
short_term_goals.ST-3: Create Benchmark v2 with new IID, State-, Parameter-, Composition-, Depth-, equivalence-, and cross-decomposition-OOD families and family-level macro reporting.
short_term_goals.ST-4: Prototype 6–12 qubit compressed/query output; qubit count alone is not the KPI.
short_term_goals.ST-5: Implement a quantum-compatible runtime with parsing, neural inference, OOD, fallback, provenance, and backend-like results.
short_term_goals.ST-6: Predeclare workload error, repeated-query speed (initially at least 10x teacher latency where feasible), memory, fallback recall, provenance, and break-even targets before results.

medium_term_goals.MT-1: QuTE Base plus Workload, Hardware, and Query adapters
medium_term_goals.MT-2: Compressed operator runtime comparing PTM, MPO, local channels, causal/light-cone representations, and latent propagators
medium_term_goals.MT-3: QPU digital twin for preview, optimization, compiler search, drift monitoring, and QPU-call reduction

long_term_goals.LT-1: Commercial AI-native quantum runtime with SDK/API, compatible backend, compiler, registry, certification, routing, QPU connectors, and accounting
long_term_goals.LT-2: Quantum workload compiler from declared family/domain/queries/accuracy/hardware through teacher generation, training, certification, and deployment
long_term_goals.LT-3: Verified simulator/QPU-call reduction at a fixed task-level error, with coverage, fallback, latency, cost, memory, and provenance
long_term_goals.LT-4: Expanded circuit, state, Hamiltonian, protocol, noise, device, and observable context only after the core representation stabilizes

R1.name: Operator-Semantic Benchmark
R1.question: Can QuTE generalize across syntactically different but physically equivalent circuit representations?

M1.name: Workload Emulator MVP
M1.question: Can one restricted repeated quantum workload run with lower latency and memory at a predeclared task error?
M1.contract: (parameterized circuit, state descriptor, observable) -> expectation / gradient / uncertainty / fallback

project_boundaries.Feynman: natural-language interpretation/explanation; may consume QuTE representations but is not Core

questions: Which QuTE product/runtime capability does this enable?
What quantum-compatible input/output contract is improved?
How does it reduce simulator/QPU calls, latency, or memory?
Does it avoid full state/full unitary output at scale?
Which physical structure is represented by construction?
What OOD/failure detector and fallback path exist?
Which task-level and systems metrics will be measured?
Which new untouched validation/test sets will be used?
Which project boundary owns this work and why?
proposal_gate.rejection_rule: REJECTED_DIRECTION_DRIFT work must not start under QuTE.

drift_warnings: larger model without a workload/generalization hypothesis
fidelity-only study with no systems metric
LLM/language feature presented as QuTE execution core
QPU replacement claims without domain/coverage limits
new simulator implementation with no learned-runtime purpose
new project whose primary output is unrelated to quantum execution

north_star_change_conditions.policy: Architecture or experiment failures do not change the North Star. Change requires a versioned ADR/proposal and substantial evidence that the fundamental product hypothesis fails.
evidence: at least three materially different real workloads fail teacher/QPU-call reduction or break-even
compressed/query outputs fail beyond small qubits
OOD detection plus fallback cannot control task-level error
training/data cost cannot be amortized in realistic repeated-query workloads
